heading: 5 Essential Responsibilities the Movement Expects from Citizens
subheading: A constitution is only as strong as the citizens willingness to live by its principles and defend its safeguards in everyday public life.
progressText: You have committed to {{count}} of 5 Citizen Duties

items.title: LEARN
items.description: Understand the Preamble and key articles. Learn how Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties empower daily life and be aware of the challenges.
items.commitment: Read the Preamble with my family once a week.

items.title: PARTICIPATE
items.description: Democracy requires ongoing engagement. Active citizenship involves attending ward committees, Gram Sabhas, and public audits.
items.commitment: Attend at least 2 local ward council meetings this year.

items.title: VOLUNTEER
items.description: Offer your time or skills to host weekly constitutional learning sessions for youth, workers, and local communities.
items.commitment: Volunteer 2 hours every month for civic literacy.

items.title: EDUCATE
items.description: Ensure young minds understand scientific temper, gender equality, and religious harmony before division takes root.
items.commitment: Gift Pocket Constitutions to young students.

items.title: DEFEND RIGHTS
items.description: Speak out peacefully when marginalized citizens face rights violations. Provide legal aid, support, or document facts.
items.commitment: Support victims of rights violations through legal aid.
